turns.text: Hello, come in. How have you been since last time?
It has been a grey week, and the weather does not help my mood much, to be honest.
Tell me more about that.
We held a small party for Arjun in the garden, cheaper but he loved it.
And how was that for you?
I had a long day yesterday and I was so tired in the evening that I just sat in front of the television. Yes, it was like that.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
I reached sixty days without a bet and Meera baked a cake.
Mm-hm. Go on.
Some days are better than others, and I try to remind myself of that when things get heavy. I keep coming back to it.
Tell me more about that.
Meera manages all the money, I get twenty pounds a week pocket money, and it is fine.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
I am not sure where to begin, there are so many things going round in my head at the moment. That is how it was.
Tell me more about that.
The train was late again this morning, so I almost did not make it on time today.
How did that feel for you?
I told my mother about the gambling and she said she knew the signs because of my father.
What went through your mind then?
I made myself a cup of tea this morning and just stood by the window for a while. I think so, yes.
Tell me more about that.
The journey here took a while, but at least I had time to gather my thoughts.
Let us stop here for today.
Thank you, see you next week.
